title: advanced paste shortcut keyboard modifier (WIN key) not releasing subsequent keystrokes open loads of windows shortcuts
summary: The author now says the Win-key latch is still present, so the July 0.100.2 suggestion is not a confirmed resolution and there is no unanswered maintainer request supporting the old waiting status. Separate Advanced Paste restoration from other input hooks on the current affected build.

next_action.reason: Thanks for confirming that the problem still occurs; the earlier suggestion to update was not a verified fix. Please provide the exact PowerToys version showing it now and confirm whether Win+Z is still your Advanced Paste shortcut. For one controlled test, keep Advanced Paste enabled but disable Grab and Move and Keyboard Manager, and note whether Windows Sticky Keys is on.
